grid.note: bar n starts at 0.3345 + 1.39536*n; grid = 8 eighths per bar (0.1744 s); shifted -31 ms to measured hat/snare transients

judgment.rule: schema v2.5 per-tap: min(0.5*g, clamp(0.45*g, 0.045, 0.11)), g = smaller neighbouring gap
judgment.note: min tap gap 0.174 s -> tightest window ±78 ms (always <= half the local gap); sparse taps ±110 ms.

chart.notes: Curated per section (one audible layer each), audited by _w4_tools/audit.py: repeated phrases share patterns, faint/off-layer taps removed, 16th bursts only where prominent in the full mix. See chart-report.md.
